name: login-failure
description: Netdisco's token exchange is a real hop that can fail on its own, so a bad credential must produce one clear message rather than a cascade of 401s from every downstream call. POST /login answers 401, and the run must stop there: no device search, no node calls, zero assets. This also documents the second failure mode that looks the same to a caller - a user without the 'api' role authenticates but has no API access, which Netdisco reports on the data calls rather than on login.
